verdict.rationale: Jev is a model/API service, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question, but the evidence pack never mentions one. What TypeSafe does document is an agent skill/Claude plugin that gives coding agents context on the API, plus an llms.txt file. These are adjacent aids, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
